sanskrit: ādigaurīsamudbhūtatejasoṃśabhavāya vaitanotu vāgvilāsaṃ me jihvāyāṃ sā sarasvatīprāsādamaṇḍanaṃ brūte sūtradhāreṣu maṇḍanaḥsa eva vidhinā kāryo devatāyataneṣvapipāvanaṃ śaṅkarasthānaṃ tatra sarvaiḥ śivo'rcitaḥcaturdaśa samutpannāḥ prāsādānāṃ ca jātayaḥsārvadhārā vimānādināgarāḥ puṣpakāṅkitāḥsarvadeveṣu kartavyāḥ śivasyāpi viśeṣataḥcaturdaśa pravartante jñeyā lokānusārataḥprāsādabhavanādīnāṃ sarvajñānamavāpyatemāsasaṅkrāntivatsādiniṣedhe kālavarjitebhuvaṃ parīkṣya siñcet tu pañcagavyena kovidaḥcatuḥṣaṣṭipadairvāstuṃ likhedvāpi śatāṃśakaiḥpūrvoktena vidhānena balipuṣpādipūjanaiḥkuberaḥ īśaḥ patayaḥ pūrvādīnāṃ diśāṃ kramātityeṣāṃ vidhivatpūjāṃ kṛtvā karma samārabhetvaidhṛtau vyatipāte bhedagdhe neṣṭaṃ kadācanasṛṣṭyā vatsamukhaṃ tatra svāmino hānikṛdyataḥdhvajāyo devanakṣatraṃ vyayāṃśau prathamau śubhauhīna āyād vyayaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ piśācastu samo'dhikaḥnavāṅgaṃ nāḍivedyādisthāpakābha . . . . yormithaḥmāsanakṣatralagnādicintanaṃ pūrvaśāstrataḥsame bhūmipradeśe tu śaṅkunā divase'thavāpāṣāṇāntaṃ jalāntaṃ vā tataḥ kūrmaṃ niveśayetardhāṅgulā tato vṛddhiḥ kāryā tithikarāvadhiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00170 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tato'rddhādi śatārddhāntaṃ kūrmo manvaṅgulo mataḥsauvarṇo rūpyajo vāpi snāpyaḥ pañcāsṛtena hiīśānādagnikoṇādvā śilāḥ sthāpyāḥ pradakṣiṇāḥbalidānaṃ ca naivedyaṃ vividhānnaṃ ghṛtaplutambrāhme puṣye mṛge maitre pauṣṇavāsavavāruṇemṛgaśīrṣe ca revatyāmuttarātritaye śubhaḥvāṭīvāpitaḍāgādisthāne kāryaṃ murālayamdevatāyatanaṃ kuryāddharmārthakāmamokṣadamdharmavṛddhirbhavedathaḥ kāmo mokṣastato nṛṇāmaiṣṭake śatakoṭighnaṃ śaile'nantaṃ phalaṃ gṛheghaṭe dhvaje pratiṣṭhāyāmevaṃ puṇyāhasaptakamkhure dvārocchraye kumbhe paṭṭe padmaśilāsu cadhvajocchrāya ca kurvīta śāntikāni caturdaśaṃpramāṇaṃ kumbhake mūlanāsike bhittibāhyataḥpīṭhasya nirgamo bāhyastathaiva cchādyakasya caprāsādamaṅgasraṃkhyā ca vārimārgāntarasthitāḥsāmānyo'yaṃ vidhistulyo hastāṅgulaśca nirgamaḥiti śrīsūtradhāramaṇḍanaviracite prāsādamaṇḍane vāstuśāstre miśrakalakṣaṇe prathamo'dhyāyaḥyathā siṃhāsanaṃ rājñāṃ prāsādasya tathaiva sājagatī pañcadhā proktā prāsādasyānurūpyataḥkramāt pañcaguṇā proktā jyeṣṭhā madhyā kanīyasīprāsāde jagatī kāryā surūpā lakṣaṇānvitādvārakāyāṃ tu kartavyā tathaiva puruṣatrayedviguṇā vāyatā kāryā sahasrāyatane vidhiḥucchrayaḥ svatribhāgena bhramaṇīnāṃ samucchrayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00170 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aṣṭāviṃśatiṣaṭtriṃśatkoṇaiḥ syuḥ pañca phālanāḥdvātriṃśatī caturthāṃśo bhūtāṃśoccā śatārddhakasūryajainaśatārddhāntaṃ kramāddvitriyugāṃśakaiḥtripado jāḍyakumbhaśca dvipadaṃ kaṇakaṃ tathādvipadaṃ khurakaṃ kuryāt saptabhāgaṃ ca kumbhakamkapotālistribhāge ca puṣpakaṇṭho yugāṃśakaiḥkarṇeṣu ca diśāṃpālāḥ prācyādiṣu pradakṣiṇāḥprākārairjalaniṣkāsaiḥ sopānaistoraṇādibhiḥtoraṇaṃ kārayet tasya paṭṭaṃ paṭṭānusārataḥbhittigarbhapramāṇena tayormadhye'thavā bhavetvicitraṃ toraṇaṃ kuryād dolā devasya tatra caekadvitricatuṣpañcarasasaptapadāntareguhyanābhistanāntaṃ vā trividho vāhanodayaḥvṛṣasya viṣṇubhāgānte sūrye vyomastanāntakamgūḍhasyāgre catuṣkā syāttadagre nṛtyamaṇḍapamjinālaye caturdikṣu sahitaṃ jinamandiramaṣṭāpadaṃ prakartavyaṃ triśālā vā varāṇakamuttare ratharandhraṃ ca proktaṃ śrīviśvakarmaṇābhinnacchandā na kartavyā prāsādāsanasaṃsthistāprāsādaṃ kārayedantarnābhivedhavivarjitamprabhā naṣṭā na bhogāya yathā tārā divākareviṣṇoragre bhavedviṣṇurjino jaine ravau raviḥśivasyāgre'nyadevasya dṛṣṭivedhe mahadbhayamsthāpayedanyadevāṃśca tatra doṣo na vidyatepṛ0 8) dṛṣṭaṃ na laṅghayet tatra hanti puṇyaṃ purākṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00170 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: catasro vāsudevasya śivasyārdhā pradakṣiṇākuryānna darśayetpṛṣṭhaṃ saṃmukhaṃ dvāralaṅghanamiti śāstravicāro'yamuttareśānadevatāḥpraṇālaṃ kārayeddhīmān jagatyāṃ ca caturdiśambrahmaviṣṇuśivārkendraguhāḥ pūrvāparāṅmukhāḥgaṇeśo dhanado lakṣmīḥ puradvāre sukhāvahāḥmātaro dhanadaścaiva śubhā dakṣiṇadiṅmukhāḥanye vidiṅmukhā devā na kartavyāḥ kadācanasūryādgaṇeśo viṣṇuśca caṇḍī śambhuḥ pradakṣiṇegaṇeśasya gṛhe tadvaccaṇḍī śaṃbhurharī raviḥiti gaṇeśāyatanamsthāpyāstasthāvatārasya mūrtayo dvārakāṃ tathāmātaro mūrtayo devā yoginyo bhairavādayaḥsthāpyāḥ sarve śivasthāne dṛṣṭivedhavivarjitāḥdakṣiṇāṅge bhavedbrahmā viparyāse bhayāvahāḥtattulyā pārvatīdevī sukhadā sarvakāmadāiti prāsādamaṇḍane jagatīdṛṣṭidoṣāyatanādhikāre dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥatīva sudṛḍhā kāryā iṣṭikācūrṇavāribhiḥardhāṅgulā bhavedvṛddhiryāvaddhastaśatārdhakampṛ0 10) pañcadig viṃśatiryāvacchatārdhaṃ ca vivardhayetsvasvodayapramāṇasya carturthāṃśena nirgamaḥcaturhaste trisārddhāṃśaṃ pādāṃśaṃ pañcahastakevṛddhirvedatriyugmaikasaṃkhyā syādaṅgulaiḥ kramāttripañcāśat samutsedhe dvāviṃtyaṃśanirgamesāntarālaṃ kapotāliḥ saptāṃśā grāsapaṭṭikā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00170 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vājisthāne'thavā kāryaṃ svaṃ svaṃ devasya vāhanamtrisārddhaṃ kaṇakaṃ sārddhaṃ caturbhirgrāsapaṭṭikāantarālamadhasteṣāmūrdhvārdhakarṇayugmakamjāḍyakumbhaḥ kaṇālī ca grāsapaṭṭī tadā bhavetlatine nirgame hīne sādhāre nirgamādhikampīṭhahīnaṃ vināśāya prāsādabhuvanādikamsa kramānnavasapteṣurāmacaṃdrauṅgulo'dhikaḥhaste haste kramādvṛddhirmanusūryanavāṅgulāhaste sūryāṅgulā vṛddhiryāvattriṃśatkarāvadhipīṭhorddhe udayaścaiva chādyānte nāgarodhikampañcādinavabhāgāntaṃ pīṭhasya pañcadhodayaḥkhurakaḥ pañcabhāgaṃ syādviṃśatiḥkumbhakastathākapotikāṣṭau mañcī syāt kartavyā navabhāgikāvasubhirbharaṇi kāryā śirāpaṭṭī daśāṃśikāchādyaṃ trayodaśāṃśoccaṃ daśabhāgairvinirgamaḥpañcaviṃśatikā jaṅghā udagmaśca trayodaśasaptabhāgā bhavenmañcī kūṭachādyasya mastakeśirāvaṭī caturbhāgā paṭṭaḥsyātpañcabhāgikaḥkumbhakasya yugāṃśena sthāvarāṇāṃ praveśakaḥalpadravye mahatpuṇyaṃ kathitaṃ viśvakarmaṇādvādaśānāṃ khurādīnāṃ bhāgasaṃkhyā krameṇa tusārddhasyārdhārdhabhāgaiḥ syāddvisārdhairdvyaṃśanirgamaḥsādhāra'ṣṭāṃśato bhittirdaśāṃśairdhāturatnajephālanīyaṃ garbhagṛha doṣadaṃ garbhamāyatambharaṇyā bharaṇaṃ śīrṣaṃ kapotālyā samaṃ bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00170 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saṣaḍaṃśaḥ sapādasya sārdho garbhasya vistarātbhavedaṣṭābhirekāṃśā kumbhastambho'rddhapañcabhiḥpṛ0 13) vyāsārdhena karoṭaṃ syādarddhayoviṣamāśrutātadadhaḥ pañcaratnāni sthāpayet śilpipūjanātvṛttaṃ mandārakaṃ kuryāt mṛṇālaṃ padmasaṃyutamudumbarasya pārśve ca śākhāyāṃ stalarūpakamtaddvayaṃ kaṇakaṃ madhye pīṭhake bāhyabhūmikādvāravyāsasama dairghyaṃ nirgamañca tadardhataḥśaṅkhapatrasamāyuktaṃ padmākārairalaṅkṛtamṣoḍaśāṅgulikā vṛddhiryāvaddhastacatuṣṭayamdvyaṅgulamatihastañca yāvaddhastaśatārdhakamdaidhyārdhena pṛthutve syācchobhanaṃ tatkalādhikampṛ0 14) sūryāṅgulā pratikaraṃ vṛddhiḥpañcakarāvadhiḥnavāntaṃ syādyugāṅgulaṃ vṛddhiḥ kāryā karaṃ pratirasahastāntakaṃ yāvat tāvatā vṛddhiriṣyatemiśrake latine caiva praśastaṃ nāgarodbhavamsiṃhāvalokane dvāraṃ nāgaraṃ śobhanaṃ matamdhātuje ratnaje caiva dāruje ca rathāruhepañcaśakhaṃ sāvabhaume triśākhaṃ maṇḍaleśvaresamaśākhaṃ dhūmāya . . . śvānarāsabhavāyasehīnaśākhaṃ na kartavyamadhikārddhaṃ sukhāvahamāpaddoṣaviśuddhyarthaṃ hrāso vṛddhirna duṣyatimadhye dvibhāgikaṃ kuryāt stambhaṃ puruṣasaṃjñakamnirgame caikabhāgena rūpastambhaḥ praśasyatedvibhāgaṃ nirgame kuryāt stambhaṃ dravyānusārataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00170 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: koṇikā stambhamadhye tu bhūṣaṇārthā hi pārśvataḥstambhaṃ śākhādikaṃ śeṣe triśākhāvadvibhājayetcaturthī svalpaśākhā ca siṃhaśākhā ca pañcamīcaturthī stambhaśākhā ca rūpaśākhā ca pañcamīstambhaśākhā bhavenmadhye rūpaśākhāgrasūtrataḥcaturthī śalyaśākhā ca gandharvā tvatha pañcamīśalyaśākhā ca siṃhākhyā mūlakarṇena saṃmitāpṛ0 16) śākhāyāñca parīvāro gaṇeśaścottarāṅgakeiti prāsādamaṇḍane vāstuśāstre pīṭhamaṇḍovaragarbhagṛha udumbarapramāṇaṃ tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥśeṣe tryaṃśe dvibhāgārccā tryaṃśonā dvārato'thavāūrdhvārcā āsanasthā ca manuviśvārkabhāgataḥbhittirdvibhāgā kartavyā ṣaṭbhāgaṃ garbhamandirammadhyamā svadaśāṃśonā pañcāṃśonā kanīyasīsaptame saptame dṛṣṭirvṛṣe siṃhe dhvaje śubhāśayanārceśaliṅgāni dvārārdhaṃ na vyatikramettadagre vaiṣṇavaṃ brāhmaṃ madhye liṅga śivasya caprāsādaśṛṅgaśṛṅgeṣu adhobhāge tu chādyakammuṇḍalīkaṃ bhāgamekaṃ bhāgena tilakastathānirādhāre mūlabhittau sādhāre bhramabhittiṣutrayodaśorddhe saptārddhe luptāni coruśṛṅgakaiḥṣaḍbāhye doṣadaṃ proktaṃ pañcamadhye na śobhanamsapādakarṇayormadhye udaye pañcaviṃśatiḥpañcādinavayugmāntaṃ khaṇḍāni teṣvanukramātaṣṭādāvaṣṭaṣaṣṭhyantaṃ caturvṛddhyā tu ṣoḍaśaūrdhvā aṣṭadaśāṃśāḥ syustiryakṣoḍaśa eva ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00170 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: trikhaṃḍāt khaṇḍavṛddhiśca yāvadaṣṭādaśaiva hidvitīyaprathame khaṇḍe kalāṣṭau dvitīye navaaṣṭadikṣu subhāgaiśca trikhaṇḍā tṛtīyā bhavetrekhāṇāṃ jāyate saṃkhyā ṣaṭpañcāśacchatadvayamvyāsasya karṇayormadhye rekhāḥ syuḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥmaṇḍo varo'ṣṭasārddhāṣṭanavāṃśaiḥ śikharodayamcaturguṇena sūtreṇa sapādaḥ śikharodayaḥsārdhamāmalasārañca padmapratrantu sārddhakamprāsādasyāṣṭamāṃśena pṛthutvakalaśāṇḍakeaṅkadigrudrasūryāṃśairviśvāṃśaistasya cocchrayaḥekatripañcasaptāṅkasiṃhasthānāni kalpayettadūrdhve śukanāsā syāt saiva prāsādanāsikāprāsādenārddhapādena tribhāganātha nirmitātavāṅgaṃ tilakaṃ karṇe kuryātprāsādabhūṣaṇamsārdhāṃśakau rathau koṇau dvauśeṣaṃ bhadramiṣyatepṛ0 19) utsedho vistarārdhena caturbhāgarvibhājayetcandrikābhāgamānena bhāgenāmalasārikāsauvarṇaṃ puruṣaṃ tatra tulī?paryaṅkaśāyinamtripatākaṃ kare vāme hṛdisthaṃ dakṣiṇa karamdhvajādhārastu kartavya īśāne nairṛte'thavāmāṅgalyeṣu ca sarveṣu kalaśaṃ sthāpayedbudhaḥgrīvāpīṭhaṃ bhavedbhāgaṃ tribhāgenāṇḍakaṃ tathāekāṃśamagre dvau mūle vahnivedāṃśakarṇikedaṇḍastattṛtīyāṃśena śilāntakalaśāntakamprāsādapṛthumānena daṇḍo jyeṣṭhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00170 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekahaste tu prāsāde daṇḍaḥ pādonamaṅgulampṛ0 20) suvṛttaḥ sāradāruśca granthikaṇṭakavarjitaḥdaṇḍadīrghaṣaḍaṃśena markaṭya ? rdhenavistaraḥdhvajo daṇḍapramāṇena dhairghyeṃ'ṣṭāṃśena vistarepure ca nagare koṭṭe rathe rājagṛhe tathāniṣpannaṃ śikharaṃ dṛṣṭvā dhvajahīnaṃ na kārayetdhvajocchrāyeṇa tuṣyanti devāśca pitarastathāpañcaśatpūrvataḥ paścādātmānañca tathādhikamiti pratimādṛṣṭipadasthānaśikharadhvajakalaśalakṣaṇādhikāraścaturtho'dhyāyaḥsūtradhāraḥ sa eva syāt sarveṣāṃ pālanakṣamaḥviśvakarmaprasādena śilpibhirmanyatāṃvacaḥbhāgasaṃkhyeti vikhyātā phālanā karṇabāhyataḥsamāṃśairviṣamaiḥ kāryā nandamedaiśca phālanāḥnāmāni jātayasteṣāmūrdhvamārgānusārataḥnavāṣṭadaśabhāgena bhramo bhittirvidhīyateprāsādo brahmaṇaḥ prokto dhīmatā viśvakarmaṇācaturbhiḥ śukanāsaistu siṃhakarṇairvirājitamtridvāre madhyajaṃ dvāraṃ dakṣiṇāsyaṃ vivarjayethomaśālā caturdvārā kvacidrājagṛhe tathāekatripañcasaptāṅkaśākhāntaiḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥbhāgārdhaṃ nirgamaṃ bhadre prakuryānmukhabhadrakamdevānāṃ tu prakartavyaṃ siṃhastatraiva śāśvataḥrathikāṃ siṃhakarṇaṃ ca bhadre śṛṅge ca siṃhakaḥagā iti ṣaḍbhāgaiśca caturasraṃ vibhājayetsamanirgamamasmācca bhadraṃ bhāgārddhanirgamaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00170 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mandiraṃ tṛtīyaṃ bhadramalayorbhadrajaṃ tyajetbhadroruśṛṅgavaiśālapratirathye subhūṣaṇaḥbhadrārdhaṃ bhāgabhāgaṃ ca bhāgārdhena vinirgamamśṛṅgayugme ca tilakaṃ karṇe dve pratirathyakaḥśikharaṃ pañcavistāraṃ mahendro rājyado nṛṇāmtyaktvaikaśṛṅgabhadrasya matālambaṃ na kārayetsitaśṛṅgastadā nāma īśvarasya sadā priyaḥtrailokyavijayo bhadraśṛṅge na kṣitivallabhaḥtrayaṃ pratirathaḥ karṇe bhāgo bhāgasamo bhavetrathoparathe tilakaṃ pratyaṅgaṃ ca rathoparibhadre śṛṅgaṃ tṛtīyaṃ ca kailāso nāma nāmataḥtathā bhadre punardadyāt tadāsau gandhamādanaḥbhadre dadyāt punaḥ śṛṅge vijayānanda ucyateśṛṅgadvayaṃ ca cchādyordhve sarvāṅgatilakastadāmahābhāgastadā nāma sarvakāmaphalapradaḥmeruścāpi samākhyātaḥ sarvadeveṣu pūjitaḥiṣṭakāśailajāmerutatphalaṃ pradakṣiṇākṛtepṛ0 24) iti vairājyādiprāsādapañcaviṃśatyadhikāre pañcamo'dhyāyaḥnandīśo mandaraścaiva śrīvṛkṣaścāmṛtodbhavaḥindranīlo mahānīlo bhūdharo ratnakūṭakaḥairāvato rājahaṃso garuḍo vṛṣabhadhvajaḥbrahmaviṣṇuśivārkāṇāmanyeṣāṃ na kadācanacaturṇāṃ kramato vṛddhiryāvadekottaraṃ śatambhadrārdhaṃ karṇatulyaṃ ca bhāgenaikena nirgamaḥkarṇo dvibhāgaḥ sūryāṃśe bhadrārdhaṃ pratirathake
source_edition: Muktabodha M00170 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhadrapārśvadvaye kāryā bhāgabhāgena nandikākoṇikā bhāgatulyā ca śeṣaṃ caturdaśāṃśavatpṛ0 25) karṇo dvibhāgaḥ koṇī ca sārddhāṃśā pṛthuvistaraiḥbhadranaṃdī bhavedbhāgā bhadrārdhaṃ yugmabhāgikamtrayaḥ pratirathāḥ karṇe bhadrārdhaṃ ca dvibhāgikamtaleṣu kramato'ṣṭāsu ke'pyāhuḥ śikharāṇi hikartavyairbhāgabhagaiśca śeṣaṃ syātṣoḍaśāṃśavattaleṣu kramataḥ prokto mūlasūtre parājitetrayastrayaḥ krameṇaiva catvāraścāṣṭame taleśikharāṇi vidheyāni viśvakarmavaco yathāsaptaiva saptame ṣaṣṭhe śirāṃsi trīṇi cāṣṭametenaikasmiṃstale'pi syuḥ śikharāṇi bahūnyapipratyaṅgaistilakāḍhyaiśca śobhitaṃ suramandirampurarājñoḥ prajādīnāṃ kartuḥ kalyāṇakārakāḥvinā bhramairnirādhārāḥ kartavyāḥ śāntimicchatāvṛttaṃ vṛttāyata caivāṣṭāsraṃ devāyalādiṣuūrdhvaṃ? tikalaśānāṃ kuryāt pṛṣṭhyagre siṃhakarṇakamkarṇayorbhrāmayet vṛttaṃ vṛttaṃ bhadrāṇi cāṣṭa hikarṇe vā śreṇayo'ṇḍānāṃ maṇḍapaṃ tatsvarūpakamvitānaphālanāśṛṅgairanekairnāgarā matāḥpīṭhato drāviḍe rekhā latāśṛṅgādisaṃyutāvibhaktidalasaṃyuktā mūrdhni śṛṅgeṇa bhūmijānāgarā bhramasaṃyuktāḥ sādhārāste prakīrtitāḥbhedāḥ pañconapañcāśatkaravṛddhyā bhavanti teekottarasahasraṃ syāt śṛṅgāṇāṃ ca śatārddhake
source_edition: Muktabodha M00170 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tathaiva mūlaśikharaṃ pañcabhūmivimānakamekaśṛṅgeṣu śṛṅgāṇi saṃbhavanti bahūnyapihimaśīrṣo daśāṃśaḥ syāt yugasārdhaśatāṇḍakesuravallabhanāmā tu proktaḥ śrīviśvakarmaṇāardhāṃśā nandikā bhadre sādhabhāgena saṃmitambhaktaścaturdaśāṃśaistu nāmnā bhuvanamaṇḍanaḥdvyekadvyarddhāṃśe sārddhāśaiścaturdaśavibhājiteratnaśīrṣo bhavenmeruḥ pañcāśataikaśṛṅgakaiḥkiraṇodbhavameruśca sapādaḥ ṣaṭśatāṇḍakaḥnāmnā kamalahaṃsaḥ syātsārddha**saptaśatāṇḍakaḥdvābhyāṃ tai svarṇaketuśca pañcasaptāṣṭaśṛṅgakaiḥsādhāreṣu prakartavyaṃ bhadre bhadrāvilokanamvṛṣabhadvajameruśca saikāṇḍakasahasravānsādhāreṣu prakartavyaṃ bhadre bhadrāvilokanamvinā rājño'nyavarṇena kṛte merau mahābhayamiti kesaryādiprāsādajātilakṣaṇe pañcacatvāriṃśanmerulakṣaṇe ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥvicitraṃ maṇḍapaṃ yena kṛtaṃ tasmai namaḥ sadāprāsādāgre prakartavyāḥ sarvadeveṣu maṇḍapāḥjinasyāgre prakartavyāḥ sarveṣāṃ tu balāṇakamdviguṇaṃ vā prakartavyāḥ maṇḍapāḥ pañcadhā matāḥdaśāntaṃ pañcataḥ sārddhadvipādonaṃ catuṣkareprāyeṇa maṇḍapaṃ sārddhaṃ dviguṇaṃ pratyalindakaiḥśukanāsā samā ghaṇṭā nyūnā śreṣṭhā nacādhikāna doṣaḥstaṃbhapādādyaiḥ samaṃ vā viṣamaṃ talamhastakamaṅgulonaṃ vā tadūrdhvaṃ mattavāraṇam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00170 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sapādaṃ tryaṃśakā vedirbhāgenāsanapeṭakamsārddhapañcāṃśakaiḥ staṃbhaḥ pādonaṃ bharaṇaṃ bhavetpādo dvibhāgastasyorddhe kartavyaśchādyakodayaḥardhāṃśorddhā kapotālirdvibhāge paṭṭavistareva**dāṣṭaraviviṃśatyā karṇe vṛttastu pañcadhādvidvistaṃbhavivṛddhyā ca ṣoḍaśo'yaṃ prakīrtitaḥcaturasraśubhastasya tathā pratirathānvitaḥkarṇodakāntareṇātha bhadrodakavibhūṣitaḥbhadrārdhaṃ mukhabhadraṃ ca śeṣaṃ ṣaṭvasubhājitemūlaprāsādavad brāhme pīṭhajaṅghādimekhalāguhaśca karṇaguhe vā bhadre candrāvalokanamguhe prakāśake vṛddhamardhodayakaroṭakamardhabhādraṃ vibhāgena pārśvayoragratastathāmuktakoṇe catuṣke dve iti dvādaśamaṇḍapāḥcaturasrādibhedena vitānairbahubhiryutāsaptaviṃśatiruktā ye maṇḍapā viśvakarmaṇāprathamo dvādaśastaṃbho dvidvistaṃbhavivardhanātkṣetrārdhasya ṣaḍaṃśonā caikāsrāṣṭāsramucyateaṣṭāsre ṣoḍaśāsre ca vṛttaṃ kuryāttadūrdhvataḥkarṇadardarikā saptabhāgena nirgamo tucchatāvidyādharaiḥ samāyuktaṃ ṣoḍaśāṣṭadivākaraiḥvidyādharaḥ pṛthutvena saptāṃśo nirgamodayaḥgajatālastu ṣaṭsārddhā prathamā dvitīyā tu ṣaṭmadhye vitānaṃ kartavyaṃ citravarṇavirājitamekādaśaśatānyeva vitānānāṃ trayodaśa
source_edition: Muktabodha M00170 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vitānāni vicitrāṇi vastracitrādibhedataḥmaṇḍapeṣu ca sarveṣu pīṭhānte raṅgabhūmikājalāśaye'tha kartavyaṃ sarveṣāṃ mukhamaṇḍapamśālāpādena garbheṇa prāsādena samaṃ bhavetekadvitricatuḥpañcarasasaptapadāntarepṛ0 32) nyūnādhikaṃ na kartavyaṃ dairghye hastāṅgulādikamaṅgaṇā tu samaṃ peṭaṃ jagatyāścāntarāṅgajamvāme'tha? dakṣiṇadvārādvādikā mattavāraṇammattavāraṇakaṃ vedī vitānatoraṇairyutādadvimānaṃ budhaiḥ proktaṃ puṣkaraṃ vārimadhyataḥekabhūmau tribhūmyantaṃ gṛhadvārasya mastakecaturghaṇṭābhivṛddhyā ca yāvadekottaraṃ śatamvedottaraśataṃ yāvat vedāṃśā vṛdviriṣyateardhodayena rathikā ghaṇṭākūṭaṃ tavaṅgakambhāgatulyaistathā siṃhairevamanyāśca lakṣitāḥiti śrīmaṇḍapabalāṇakaṃ saṃvarṇādhikāraḥ saptamo'dhyāyaḥviśvakarmaprasādena viśeṣeṇa prakathyateghaṭiteṣu vidhātavyamarcāliṅgeṣu śāstrataḥsvaśalyaṃ pādahīnaṃ tu tacca vāstu vinaśyatiprāsāde na bhavetpūjā gṛhe tu na va . . . . tpattiḥacālyaṃ sarvadeśeṣu cālite rāṣṭravibhramaḥjīrṇānyuddharate yastu puṇyamaṣṭaguṇaṃ labhethīne tu jāyate hāniradhike tu dhanakṣayaḥśailaje dhātuje caiva dhātuje ratnaje'thavātatra mūhamamūhaṃ vā yatra tīrthaṃ samāhitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00170 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: svayambhūbāṇaliṅgeṣu tatra doṣo na vidyatedārujaṃ puruṣārthaṃ ca ata ūdhvaṃ na cālayettatra sthānasthitā devā bhagnāḥ pūjāphalapradāḥavyaṅgaṃ cālitaṃ nṝṇāṃ dāruṇaṃ kurute bhayamācāryaḥ śilpibhiḥ prājñaiḥ śāstradṛṣṭyāsamuddharettasya śṛṅgeṇa dantena patitaṃ pātayetsudhiḥchidrasandhiśca kārāśca mahādoṣā iti smṛtāḥśikhābhirjālakairdvārai raśmivātaprabhedidamjinagaurīgaṇeśānāṃ gṛhaṃ bhinnaṃ vivarjayetatha svāmiśarīraṃ syātprāsādamapi tādṛśammiśrakaṃ pūjitaṃ tatra bhinnaṃ vai doṣakāraṇamutpadyate mahāmarma jātibhede kṛte satiapadasthāpite stambhe mahārogaṃ vinirdiśetprāsāde pīṭhahīne tu naśyanti gajavājinaḥprāsāde pīṭhahīne tu naśyanti gajavājinaḥkarṇahīne surāgāre phalaṃ tatra na vidyateśikhare hīnamāne tu putrapautradhanakṣayaḥtasmācchāstrīyamānena sukhadaṃ sarvakāmadammaṇḍapena ca prāsādo grasto vai doṣakārakaḥchāyābhedena kartavyā tathā liṅgasya pīṭhikāekadvivedasāhasrahastaiḥ syādrājamandiramdairghyatulyaṃ sapādāṣṭaṃ sārdhāṃśenādhikaṃ śubhamṣaṭtriṃśat ṣaṭvivṛdhyā ca yāvadekottaraṃ śatamkīrtistambhairjalārāmairgehairmaṇḍaiḥ suśobhitamyadi nāmāśramaṃ kuryātsatataṃ dvitribhūmikam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00170 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mattavāraṇamagre ca tadūrdhvaṃ paṭṭabhūmiṣupuṣyagehaṃ tatheśāne nairṛtyeśāntamāyudhammaṭhasyoparitaḥ kuryādvidyāvyākhyānamaṇḍapamraveḥ saumyāyane kuryāddevānāṃ sthāpanādikampuṣye haste mṛge svātau rauhiṇyāṃ śrutimaitrabhedagdhāṃ tithiṃ ca gaṇḍāntaṃ cārabhopagrahaṃ tyajetabhiṣekaḥ pratiṣṭhā ca praveśādikamiṣyatetripañcasaptanandaikādaśaviśvakarānanamṣoḍaśa hastataḥ kuṇḍa vaśādadhika iṣyatemaṇḍapaṃ vedikāmadhye pañcāṣṭanavakuṇḍakampṛ0 37) āgamairvedamantraiśca homaṃ kuryādvidhānataḥtrihastaṃ lakṣahome syāddaśalakṣe catuṣkaramaśītilakṣe'drikaraṃ koṭihome'ṣṭahastakammekhalātritayaṃ veda rāmayugmāṅgulaiḥ kramātbrahmaviṣṇuravīnāṃ tu sarvatobhadramiṣyateliṅgodbhavaṃ śivasyāpi latāliṅgodbhavaṃ tathāardhacandraṃ taḍāgeṣu cāpākāraṃ tathaiva capīṭhikājalapādeṣu yonyākāraṃ tu kāmadamṭaṅkābhaṃ caturasraṃ ca gajadantamihāyatampūrvāditoraṇaṃ plakṣayajñāṅgavaṭapippalaiḥkulīnānaṅgasarvajñānyajñārthamabhimantrayetsthaṇḍilaṃ bālukaṃ kṛtvā śamyayā snāpayetsuramsnāpayetpañcakalaśaiḥ śatavāraṃ jalena cavastreṇācchādayeddevaṃ vedyāṃtaṃ maṇḍapaṃ nayetkalaśaṃ tu śirodeśe pādasthāne kamaṇḍalum
source_edition: Muktabodha M00170 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: puṣparāgaṃ ca gomedaṃ caṃdraṃ pūrvādito nyasetratnanyāsaṃ tataḥ kuryāddikpālādikapūjanamnairṛtye vāstupūjā ca vāyavye mātaraḥ smṛtāḥpuṣparāgaṃ ca gomedaṃ candraṃ pūrvādiṣu yajetvaṅgaṃ lohaṃ ca pūrvādidikṣu dhātūniha nyasetśaṅkhinījyotiṣmatī caiva svariktāni kramānnyasetśālimudrāḥ samākhyātā godhūmāśca krameṇa tutatsarvaṃ śilpine deyamācāryāya tu yājñikamnaivedyārārtikaṃ pūjāmaṅganyāsādikaṃ tathāṣaḍrasāḥ svādubhakṣāṇi samantāt parikalpayetsakalīkaraṇaṃ jīvanyāsaṃ kṛtvā pratiṣṭhayetkharaśilāyāṃ ca vārāhaṃ paulyāṃ nāgakulāni canandinī jāḍyakumbhe ca kalyāṇyāṃ sthāpayeddharimnarapīṭhe narāṃścaiva kṣamāṃ ca khurake yajetkapotālyāṃ ca gandharvānmañcikāyāṃ sarasvatīmsāvitrīṃ bharaṇe deśe śirāvadyāṃ ca devikāmparyaṅkakuṃṭhacchādye ca tato madhye pratiṣṭhayetudumbare sthitaṃ yakṣamaśvināvardhacandrakestambheṣu parvatāṃścaivamākāśaṃ ca karoṭakeśikharasyoruśṛṅgeṣu pañca pañca pratiṣṭhayetśikhare ceśvaraṃ devaṃ śikhāyāṃ tu surādhipampadmākṣaṃ padmapatraṃ ca kalaśe ca sadāśivamkarṇādibhadraparyantaṃ pañcāṅge tān pratiṣṭhayetvipraṃ kumārikāṃ vāstuṃ tato lokānpradarśayetvastrālaṅkārabhūvittagomahiṣyāśvavāhanaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00170 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: svādhikārānusāreṇa vastratāmbūlabhojanaiḥbhuñjate tatra bhoktāsau śaṅkarastridaśaiḥ sahasūtradhāro vadet svāminna kṣayaṃ bhavatāt tavadānaṃ dadyāddvijātibhyo dīnāndhadurbaleṣu cavitte datte pratuṣyanti mānuṣyāḥ pitaraḥ surāḥnavakāraiḥ sūramantraiśca siddhiḥ kevalabhāṣitampṛ0 41) yenānantavibhedena muktimārga udāhṛtaḥsiddha kālatrayo jātāścaturviṃśatimūrtayaḥsāvantaśikharaṃ? mandiramaṣṭāpadādikamkalyāṇakārivargasya caturdikṣu prakalpayettaḍāgasya caturmāsaṃ kuryādāṣāḍhamārgayoḥsaṃskṛte tṛptimāyānti tasmātsaṃskāramācaretdatte vā sa labhetsaukhyamurvyāṃ svarge ca mānavaḥsvedastasmātsamudbhūtaṃ bhūtamatyantaduḥsahamjānunī koṇayo pādau rakṣo diśi śive śiraḥdevyo'ṣṭau bāhyagāsteṣāṃ vasanādvāsturucyatetenaiva balinā śānti kurute hānimanyathāvāstukarmasu sarveṣu pūjitāḥ saukhyado bhavetdvātriṃśanmaṇḍalāni syuḥ kṣetratulyākṛtīni casarvavāstuvibhāgeṣu pūjayenmaṇḍaladvayamjayaḥskandhe mahendrādyāḥ pañca dakṣiṇabāhugāḥvāyurjānuni pūṣādyāḥ saptapādatale sthitāḥgandharvo bhṛṅgarājaśca mṛgaḥ sapta surā itidauvāriko'tha sugrīvaḥ puṣpadanto jalādhipaḥahirmukhyaśca bhallāṭaḥ somasarpauca bāhugau
source_edition: Muktabodha M00170 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dvātriṃśadbāhyagā devā nābhipṛṣṭhe sthito vidhiḥvivasvāna'tha mitraśca dakṣavāmorugāvubhausāvitraḥ savitā tadvatkaraṃ dakṣiṇamāśritaubhadradāso'pi tatraiva iti devamayaṃ vapuḥvidārikāgnikoṇe ca vijṛmbhāpāṃdigāsthitāpāparākṣasikā saumye'ryamā vai sarvato'rcayetaparān vaṭakānnaiśca sarvān svarṇasugandhibhiḥiti śrīsūtradhāramaṇḍanaviracite vāstuśāstre prāsādamaṇḍane'ṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00170 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]
